arguments.command:
bash -lc 'python3 - <<"PY"
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
W,H=900,480
img=Image.new("RGB",(W,H), color=(255,255,255))
draw=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
# Title bar
draw.rectangle([(0,0),(W,60)], fill=(230,230,230))
try:
    font=ImageFont.truetype("DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", 28)
except Exception:
    font=None
text="Settings region — Cassette selected"
draw.text((20,15), text, fill=(0,0,0), font=font)
# Cassette region sample
start_y=100
line_h=28
pos= start_y
draw.text((40,pos), "Screen: Cassette", fill=(0,0,0), font=None)
pos+=line_h
draw.text((60,pos), "variant: color scheme", fill=(0,0,0), font=None)
pos+=line_h
draw.text((40,pos), "Display region (for reference)", fill=(120,120,120), font=None)
pos+=line_h
draw.text((60,pos), "text size: 1.0", fill=(0,0,0), font=None)
pos+=line_h
draw.text((60,pos), "haptics: on", fill=(0,0,0), font=None)
# Save
img.save("assets/screenshot_settings_cassette.png")
print("done")
PY
'
